slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Since the 4-month contract must cover all 4 months and the requirement must be exactly matched each month, does choosing a 4-month contract mean it must cover the full required area in every month (1500, 1000, 2000, 1200), or can it cover a fixed area across all 4 months?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the 4-month contract's coverage behavior, which is related to full-term coverage, but did not explicitly ask whether a signed contract must remain active for all months in its term or whether partial usage is allowed.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether the plan must include at least two distinct contract lengths or whether a single contract type is acceptable.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any limit on the number of distinct contract lengths or types that can be signed.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: If a contract's area is rented for more months than a given month requires, is the excess area in that month simply unused (no penalty, no refund), or does it have to be exactly matched to the requirement each month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether monthly rented area must exactly match the requirement or whether excess is allowed, directly covering the exact-satisfaction slot.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total rental cost over the 4 months?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirmed the optimization objective as minimizing total rental cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to diversify contract lengths; any combination of contract lengths is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the contract-length diversity constraint, so treating it as absent was unconfirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no cap on the number of distinct contract types that can be signed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a maximum number of distinct contracts, so assuming no cap was unconfirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped after resolving the P0 slots but never asked about the P1 contract-length diversity requirement, leaving a material hidden slot unresolved.

summary: The agent recovered the core P0 objective and exact-demand requirements, but missed the P1 contract-length diversity rule and the P2 distinct-contract cap, and it became stuck repeatedly asking an unresolved unit-discretization question.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
